role: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis: computes DFA alpha1 (box sizes 4-16) and alpha2 (16-64) with R² from clean RR intervals, using log-spaced box sizes and per-box least-squares detrending.
types: DFAAnalyzer: enum — namespace for DFA computation
DFAAnalyzer.DFAResult: struct — alpha1, alpha2?, alpha1R2, alpha2R2?
toplevel: No stored state. Box-size defaults come from HRVConstants.DFA (Utilities/Constants.swift:185-188); alpha2 additionally needs HRVConstants.MinimumBeats.forDFA = 256 beats (Constants.swift:163).

units.does: Returns DFAResult for >=64 RR intervals: integrates the series, builds log-spaced box sizes for alpha1 (4..min(16,n/4)) and alpha2 (16..min(64,n/4)), regresses log F(n) on log n for alpha1, and adds alpha2 only when alpha2Exponent allows; nil when fewer than 64 beats, fewer than 3 alpha1 box sizes, or the alpha1 regression has no exponent (a degenerate series such as constant intervals).

branches.effect: false: returns nil (reachable through a narrow custom alpha1Range); true: computes alpha1

units.does: Cumulative sum of (rr - mean) using vDSP mean: the DFA integrated profile.

branches.effect: accumulates deviation into integrated[i]; empty input yields []

units.does: Alpha2 exponent and R²: nil unless there are >=3 alpha2 box sizes and >=256 beats and the log-log regression yields an exponent.

branches.effect: false: returns nil (DFAResult.alpha2/alpha2R2 nil); true: the regression's (slope, r2), or nil when it has none

units.does: Integer box sizes from lower to upper spaced by ratio 2^(1/8), deduplicated after rounding, with upper appended if missing.

branches.effect: true: appends upper so the range end is always included; false: unchanged

units.does: RMS fluctuation F(n): splits the integrated profile into non-overlapping boxes of boxSize, sums detrended squared residuals, returns sqrt(total / (boxes*boxSize)); trailing remainder beats are dropped.

branches.effect: false: returns 0 (later mapped to log -10 by logLogRegression); true: computes

units.does: Sum of squared residuals of one box after subtracting its least-squares line; falls back to the raw sum of squares when <2 points or the fit is degenerate.

branches.effect: false: returns raw sum of squares (untrended); true: residual sum

units.does: Closed-form least-squares slope/intercept of segment values against their 0-based index; nil when the denominator is 0.

Regresses log(fluctuation) on log(box size) via Statistics.linearRegression over the box sizes with a positive fluctuation (a zero one has no logarithm and is left out); nil when fewer than two remain or the regression fails, rather than an exponent of 0.
